rules: No generic fonts for headings (NEVER use Inter for headings).
Headings must use tight letter spacing: tracking-tighter.
Do not exceed text-6xl for the maximum heading size.
Hierarchy gap between heading and subheading must not exceed 2 Tailwind steps.
Use Deep Obsidian base with Safety Yellow as the primary interaction color.
Tint neutral greys slightly to make them feel alive.
Ensure minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio for normal text.

visual_enhancers.surface_strategy: Grid Borders (The Technical Look) & Flat Solid surfaces.
visual_enhancers.corners: Sharp edges, max 2px border-radius (rounded-sm) for a rugged industrial feel.
visual_enhancers.textures: Use subtle noise/grain or blueprint grids over flat backgrounds.
rules: No Glassmorphism. Use flat solid surfaces for data clarity in this industrial app.
DO NOT use complete transparent backgrounds for dropdowns, overlays, or sticky headers.

layouts.grid_structure: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-4 or gap-6.
layouts.spacing_philosophy: Dense and compact spacing for data correlation in dashboards. Generous padding in forms.
layouts.alignment: Left-align paragraphs, labels, dense content. Mobile-first grids.
layouts.navigation: Fixed Sidebar or Top Navigation Cockpit. Must have solid background, no transparency.

components.forms: Use Shadcn components. Strip default soft styles, make them sharp and rugged.
components.tables: Use Shadcn Data Table. Dense rows for data correlation.
components.charts: Use Recharts or Shadcn charts. Color-blind-friendly industrial palettes (Yellow, Orange, Blue, Gray).
components.buttons: Sharp buttons (rounded-sm) with strong hover interaction (hover:bg-primary/90 hover:text-black).
components.cards: Go cardless or use flat, rectangular, dense styles with 1px border. No shadows.

motion.animations: Minimalist micro-interactions. No bouncing or over-the-top animations.
motion.hover_states: ALWAYS explicitly set text color on hover. Slight lift or border color darken for cards.

accessibility.contrast: Meet APCA/WCAG standards. Focus states must have higher contrast.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., login-submit-button, operator-payroll-table).
accessibility.forms: Ensure clear error states and validation messages.

dashboard_hero.description: Yellow excavator working on site, perfect for header or banner.

spare_parts_banner.description: Yellow and black excavator parts, suitable for spare parts module.

icons.style: Use for dense dashboards and operational precision.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use dark mode as the default for this industrial dashboard.
Implement a role-based layout (Admin vs Operator) ensuring operators only see their own data.
Use Phosphor Icons for a technical, precise look.
Customize Shadcn UI to have sharp edges (`rounded-sm` or `rounded-none`) and flat borders.
Use Sonner for toasts (yarn add sonner), configure it in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.js.
DO NOT use raw HTML inputs/selects for complex interactions, use Shadcn equivalents.
Ensure the dashboard features summary charts using Recharts.
Apply `data-testid` attributes to all actionable elements.
No centered layouts for dense text. Align left.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific elements excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is strictly forbidden).
Always use modern button styles (sharp/rugged for this theme) with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (like robot, brain, lightbulb) for icons.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
